items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: I had Ron Carter doing funky lines you know? ... Ron Carter played the same thing but he played it with so much soul and so much feeling

ctx.x: Yeah. Oh I had Ron Carter doing funky lines you know? You look at “Transmogrification” a tune on one of JB’s albums, one of the first albums. And Ron © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Carter played the same thing but he played it with so much soul and so much feeling that you thought he was playing “So What.” You know? Yeah.
